answer: Beacon spot-checks with a compute heartbeat stop bulk fake identities. Each epoch the beacon picks 5% of agents; each picked agent must solve a puzzle within 90 seconds, proving one machine per identity. 1,000 aliases need 1,000 machines, so at zenith traffic it costs 1,000 x 40 POA, about 40,000 POA against a 5,000 POA pool. Honest agents pay nothing extra, one machine, one heartbeat, and keep their reward undiluted past the ridge of fakes.
